build_adaptive_padding: build an AdaptivePadding module to pad tensor inputs with corner or same mode for convolution coverage
build_patch_merging: build a PatchMerging layer to downsample patch feature maps using nn.Unfold with normalization and linear reduction
build_ffn: build a FeedForwardNetwork (FFN) module with configurable fully-connected layers, activation, dropout, and optional identity connection
build_deformable_detr_transformer: build a DeformableDETR transformer with multi-scale deformable attention, optional two-stage proposals, and reference point refinement
build_dynamic_conv: build a DynamicConv module that generates per-sample convolution parameters and applies 1x1 convolution via batch matrix multiplication
